# Native Android activity fixtures

These twelve immutable artifacts come from the concrete Android host-core controls at the producer revision in `provenance.json`. `android-v6-activity` uses synthetic post-capture models to verify frozen metadata, source-only records and counts beyond signed Int. The two `captured` variants use real Health Connect SDK record classes through the production pinned-calendar range reader, with IPC substituted; they verify available versus unavailable activity intensity. The unavailable family is never queried or exported. All variants retain exact source clocks across the New York DST fold; elapsed intensity seconds retain the fractional interval.

The real host Rust planner prepares all four formats. This is not provider/device or physical-vault qualification, and Morning ends remains production-gated. The provenance manifest records each variant's scope and every produced byte hash.
